text: In this month we spoke, in retrospect, mostly two lines. Forty-six of us said "balanced budget amendment," peaking 2018-04-12; Mike Lee had said it first. Forty-six of us said "faa reauthorization act," peaking 2018-04-27; Kevin Cramer had said it first. Forty-four of us said "a balanced budget," and thirty-six said "a balanced budget amendment," both peaking the same day, 2018-04-12. Forty of us said "secretary of state" by 2018-04-26. Thirty-nine said "the faa reauthorization," thirty-eight said "the faa reauthorization act," both peaking 2018-04-27. Thirty-seven of us said "speaker paul ryan," peaking 2018-04-11. We record that our two heaviest phrases converged on two days: the twelfth for the budget, the twenty-seventh for the FAA. We said the same things, and we are noting how many of us said each.
